theorems.name: Submission.aal_lintegral_closedBall_le_of_annuli
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (s M : ℝ), 0 < s → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → g y = 0 → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < s → IntegrableOn g (closedBall y s \ closedBall y t) μ ∧ ∫ x in closedBall y s \ closedBall y t, g x ∂μ ≤ M) → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
